page_title: Applite: an app store for the apps that aren’t on the App Store

sources.entry: Applite - User-friendly GUI app for Homebrew Casks. Install, update, and uninstall apps with a single click. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/milanvarady/Applite)

summary.name: Applite
summary.one_liner: Applite is a free, open-source macOS app store front-end that installs, updates and removes Mac apps (including non-App Store apps) with one click, using Homebrew under the hood.
keywords: install mac apps without app store
mac apps not on app store
use_cases: Setting up a brand new Mac with a list of apps
Installing Mac apps that are not on the App Store
Updating all installed apps in one place
Uninstalling an app along with its leftover settings and support files
Migrating an app list from an old Mac
summary.what_it_does: Applite lets you browse by category or search by name for Mac apps, most of which are not on the Mac App Store. Installs are one-click, replacing drag-to-Applications and installer windows. An Update All option updates all apps in one place. You can export your app list from an old Mac, tick the apps you want, and install them together on a new one. Uninstalling can also remove the app's settings and support files in the same step. It uses Homebrew internally, which Applite bundles and sets up automatically on first launch.
notable: Uses Homebrew casks under the hood, bundled and set up automatically with no prior install needed
Signed and notarised by Apple; no accounts, analytics or telemetry
MIT licensed open source with the code publicly readable
Can export an app list from one Mac and install the selected apps together on another
caveats: Most listed apps are Homebrew casks, so availability depends on what Homebrew provides
